note: Quantities the manuscript states that appear inside no reports/ file. The disclosed test count is one: it is measured, not looked up, and it went stale once already -- the manuscript said thirty-three while a bare clone ran forty-seven. Since the frozen-matrix-v2 revision it is measured from a `git archive` extract of the release commit, which is what the Zenodo deposit contains, rather than from a clone. tests/test_reported_numbers.py compares the manuscript against this file.
bare_clone_measured_for: HEAD at 5099eb3 plus this round's fixes: the twelve stages added to reproduce_calibration.py, the reproduction-coverage gate, and the committed fixture that replaced the pre-fix-draft skip; no configuration, no API keys

bare_clone_breakdown.isolation: HOME pointed at an empty directory, so no manuscript is visible
bare_clone_breakdown.skips_are: the three tests that read the manuscript: the two anchor-resolution tests and the disclosed-count check. The pre-fix-draft regression no longer skips: it runs against tests/fixtures/pre_fix_clinical_yield.docx, which is tracked, so it no longer depends on a backup on the author's machine

archive_measured_for: git archive of commit 9b6d362 (code, figures and tests of the v2 review round); re-measured on the manuscript-support commit that follows it, which adds no tests

archive_breakdown.how: git archive --format=tar HEAD | tar -x; python -m pytest -q -rs from the extract root with the repository's pinned virtualenv (python 3.12.14; pip install -r requirements.txt plus pyarrow and python-docx, which the tests import); HOME pointed at an empty directory and VARIANT_FM_MANUSCRIPT unset, so no manuscript is visible
skips_are: tests/test_reproduction_coverage.py::test_every_tracked_result_has_a_documented_entry_point -- 'no tracked report files': it enumerates tracked outputs with `git ls-files`, and an archive extract carries no git index; in a clone of the same commit it runs and passes

with_manuscript_visible.skip_is: the git-index coverage check above; it is the only test that cannot run from an archive
